description.describe_ch: 旨在訓練學生繪圖能力及訓練，培養學生對材料質感搭配，並經由美術史講解增加學生構圖、顏色、判斷力。
description.describe_eh: The goal of the class is to enable students' drawing capability, and to cultivate good sense on the arrangement of material textures. History of fine arts shall be explained to make sense of the judgment of picture composition and color.

targets.describe_ch: 本課程的目的是向學生介紹各種建築繪圖表現方法、各種徒手繪圖之材料和技巧，以及作為探索和表達建築意象和設計思考手段相關的創意表現。
targets.describe_en: The aim of this course is to introduce students to various architectural drawing conventions, freehand drawing media and techniques, and creative drawing as a means of exploring and communicating architectural interpretations and design ideas.

targets.describe_ch: 本課程通過應用基本素描、構圖方法、或是模型製作實習，培養學生延伸其在建築表現上的技能。
targets.describe_en: This course extends the training of students’ skills in architectural presentation by application of basic drawing, composition, or modeling and rendering practice.

targets.describe_ch: 本課程更複雜的學習內容可包括設計素描或是模型製作，目的在幫助學生掌握建築表現的重要特點：例如材料性，觸感，紋理，色調和顏色等。
targets.describe_en: More complex projects of professional drawing or model-making are designed to help students grasp important features of architectural presentation, such as materiality, tactility, texture, tone, and colour.
